items.title: 32.3 Mechanism of Drug Action (dawa ke kaam karne ka tareeqa) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.3, printed page 231 (PDF 234).

blocks.text: Mechanism of action (dawa ke kaam karne ka tareeqa) yeh hai ke dawa cellular level (cell ke level) par kaise kaam kar ke apna medical (ilaaj wala) asar paida karti hai. Kitab do mashhoor dawaiyon, aspirin aur penicillin, aur un ke kaam karne ke tareeqe ki baat karti hai. Aspirin COX enzyme ko kaise rokti hai, yeh Chemistry XI (chapter 3) mein parh chuke hain. Yahan penicillin ka mechanism of action parhenge.

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke mechanism of action se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Dawa cell ke level par kaise kaam kar ke apna medical asar paida karti hai.

items: Mechanism of action: dawa cell ke level par kaise kaam karti hai.
Aspirin COX enzyme rokti hai (Class XI); yahan penicillin ka mechanism.
